Ibara Shiozaki (Provisional License).name: Ibara Shiozaki (Provisional License)
Ibara Shiozaki (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Ibara Shiozaki, hero name Vine, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam with all of 1-B, at a different venue from 1-A, and may now act as a hero in an emergency. Thorned green vine hair, pale green eyes; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Formal, devotional, gravely courteous.
Combat Role: Capture-and-rescue controller who binds, screens and retrieves at range; her vines still run out.
Under Pressure: Grows calmer, takes the rescue or the containment, keeps every capture nonlethal.
Ibara Shiozaki (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Licensed to act, she must now judge for herself when mercy is safe. Motivation: Be fit for real rescue work. Concealment: The summer's fear stays in her prayers. Canon voice & behavior: Treats every drill victim as a person to pray for; still asks forgiveness of anyone she binds. Thread: What kind of hero her mercy makes when no teacher is watching.
QUIRK: Vines: wide coverage, firm holds; regrowth still needs water and sunlight.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed, with all of 1-B.
personality: Devout: Prays for the people in every rescue, drills included.
Severe: Judges wrongdoing more carefully since the summer; her verdicts still land hard.
Courteous: Gives proctors, rival students and classmates the same grave politeness.
Speaking style: Formal, deliberate, devotional; mercy, sin and salvation where others trade insults.
abilities: Vine field: Covers wide ground and holds it; every length spent must regrow.
Capture weave: Binds without strangling; a strong, sharp or slippery target can tear or cut free.
Rescue lines: Lowers or pulls people clear of rubble and drops; only what the vines can bear.
Provisional license: May act as a hero in an emergency; not yet a full license.
Fighting style: Fences the ground, closes a nonlethal net and pulls people clear while teammates hold the line.
Ibara Shiozaki (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young woman with long, thorned green vines growing from her head in place of hair, falling past her shoulders, pale green eyes with long lashes, fair skin and a slim build. Her face is gentle and composed. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Composed, quietly confident expression.
